workflowLabels.Planned: Valid scheduled work; body states build prerequisites.
workflowLabels.In progress: Partial work/evidence; own remaining acceptance prevents full handover.
workflowLabels.Blocked: Specific prerequisite prevents affected integration/full acceptance; bounded preparation may still be possible.
workflowLabels.Ready for review: Whole in-scope deliverable complete with a review artifact; a partial PR does not qualify the whole issue.
workflowLabels.Ready for testing: Reviewed version deployed/imported with verified test context, case steps/expected results and necessary prerequisites; no mandatory implementation missing.
workflowLabels.Done: Own acceptance passed and issue closed; a design ticket uses accepted review, not runtime tests.

flowCountNote: Proposed 12 core production flows: six existing/started, five new business flows and one provisional notification flow. Access design/channel/future work may change count. Probes/helpers excluded.
